remarks: What an opportunity to own a piece of land bordered by Chestnut ridge on 2 sides, This is a 2 acre buildable lot with the Town of Orchard Park. The lot currently has a 2 car garage. The property is perfect for outdoor enthusiasts who want to take advantage of all the year around amenities at Chestnut Ridge park right in their backyard. There currently is a path that runs the middle of the 2 acres to be able to enjoy a walk to the back of the property. At the back of the property there is easy access to park trails, one which leads to the sought out Eternal Flame. In the winter the trails are easy to get to for snowmobiling, cross country skiing, and snow shoeing. The property has been surveyed and markers are easily accessible. Walking the property is permitted only after registering showing with Listing agent.
